name: PFS Free Domains
author: PublicFreeSuffix
description: Find and register free domains across seven live public suffixes, then manage DNS records, WHOIS lookups, SSL certificates, and free hosting without leaving the conversation. Includes the SEUS community side: posts, feeds, media, and comments. Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint with SEUS OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) sign-in - no API key needed.
